drafts.to: All members of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd
drafts.subject: Notice of Special General Body Meeting: rooftop solar for common facilities
drafts.body:
Notice is hereby given that a Special General Body Meeting of the members of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd will be held on [to be set by committee] in the society premises to transact the following business:

1. To consider and approve, in principle, the installation of a 36 kW grid-connected rooftop solar power plant on the society terrace for the common facilities (lifts, water pumps, common lighting).
2. To consider the estimated project cost of Rs 18,00,000, the central financial assistance of Rs 6,48,000 available under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, and the net cost to the society of Rs 11,52,000, with an estimated simple payback of about 3.3 years.
3. To decide how the cost and the savings will be shared among members: an equal share per flat, or in proportion to flat area.
4. To authorise the Managing Committee to apply on the national rooftop solar portal, obtain approvals from Nagar Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. (NVVNL), and select a vendor registered on the PM Surya Ghar National Portal after comparing quotations.
5. Any other matter with the permission of the Chair.

The figures above are estimates prepared from the society's electricity bills. They will be confirmed with vendor quotations and the DISCOM before any order is placed. Members are requested to attend. If there is no quorum, the meeting will stand adjourned as per the bye-laws of the society.

By order of the Managing Committee


Hon. Secretary

drafts.subject: Draft resolution for the General Body Meeting
drafts.body:
RESOLVED THAT the General Body of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd hereby approves, in principle, the installation of a grid-connected rooftop solar power plant of about 36 kW for the common facilities of the society.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the net cost after central financial assistance, and the resulting savings, be shared among members on an equal share per flat.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Managing Committee be and is hereby authorised to apply on the national rooftop solar portal, to obtain the required approvals from Nagar Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. (NVVNL), to invite and compare quotations from vendors registered on the National Portal, and to place a work order only after DISCOM feasibility approval.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Hon. Secretary be authorised to sign and submit all documents required for the above purpose.

drafts.subject: Your quotation for the rooftop solar plant at Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd
drafts.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your quotation. After reviewing it, the Managing Committee proposes the following terms:

Yours faithfully,
For Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd


Hon. Secretary

drafts.subject: Documents required before we consider your quotation

Notice is hereby given that a Special General Body Meeting of the members of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd will be held on [to be set by committee] in the society premises to transact the following business:

1. To consider and approve, in principle, the installation of a 36 kW grid-connected rooftop solar power plant on the society terrace for the common facilities (lifts, water pumps, common lighting).

By order of the Managing Committee


Hon. Secretary

drafts.to: All members of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd
drafts.subject: Notice of Special General Body Meeting: rooftop solar for common facilities
drafts.body:
Notice is hereby given that a Special General Body Meeting of the members of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd will be held on [to be set by committee] in the society premises to transact the following business:

1. To consider and approve, in principle, the installation of a 36 kW grid-connected rooftop solar power plant on the society terrace for the common facilities (lifts, water pumps, common lighting).
2. To consider the estimated project cost of Rs 18,00,000, the central financial assistance of Rs 6,48,000 available under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, and the net cost to the society of Rs 11,52,000, with an estimated simple payback of about 3.3 years.
3. To decide how the cost and the savings will be shared among members: an equal share per flat, or in proportion to flat area.
4. To authorise the Managing Committee to apply on the national rooftop solar portal, obtain approvals from Nagar Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. (NVVNL), and select a vendor registered on the PM Surya Ghar National Portal after comparing quotations.
5. Any other matter with the permission of the Chair.

The figures above are estimates prepared from the society's electricity bills. They will be confirmed with vendor quotations and the DISCOM before any order is placed. Members are requested to attend. If there is no quorum, the meeting will stand adjourned as per the bye-laws of the society.

By order of the Managing Committee


Hon. Secretary

drafts.subject: Draft resolution for the General Body Meeting
drafts.body:
RESOLVED THAT the General Body of Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd hereby approves, in principle, the installation of a grid-connected rooftop solar power plant of about 36 kW for the common facilities of the society.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the net cost after central financial assistance, and the resulting savings, be shared among members on an equal share per flat.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Managing Committee be and is hereby authorised to apply on the national rooftop solar portal, to obtain the required approvals from Nagar Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. (NVVNL), to invite and compare quotations from vendors registered on the National Portal, and to place a work order only after DISCOM feasibility approval.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Hon. Secretary be authorised to sign and submit all documents required for the above purpose.

drafts.subject: Your quotation for the rooftop solar plant at Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd
drafts.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your quotation. After reviewing it, the Managing Committee proposes the following terms:

1. Total price: Rs 16,27,500, inclusive of GST.
2. Advance: 5% with the work order; the balance linked to delivery and commissioning.
3. Free operation and maintenance: 5 years.
4. The work order will be placed only after DISCOM feasibility approval.

Kindly confirm these terms in writing. Please note that this letter is not a work order.

Yours faithfully,
For Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd


Hon. Secretary

drafts.subject: Documents required before we consider your quotation
drafts.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your quotation. Before the Managing Committee can consider it, kindly send:

1. Proof of your registration as a vendor on the PM Surya Ghar National Portal (the subsidy is paid only for registered vendors).
2. Your GST registration certificate.
3. Details of at least two housing society projects you have completed, with contact persons.
4. Your panel warranty, inverter warranty and free maintenance terms, which are not stated in the quotation.

We will not discuss price until these are received and verified.

Yours faithfully,
For Sunrise Apartments CHS Ltd


Hon. Secretary
